market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1–3 month window as US Fed-hike fears persist, AUD weakens, and Australian housing data deteriorate. The 'bull case returns' narrative (#59) is premature given credit contraction and construction fragility. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US data prints.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if the RBA pivots dovish on softening domestic data. EV transition, AI/defence capex, and critical-minerals demand provide structural growth. However, a prolonged housing downturn and iron ore shakeout cap upside for financials and materials. Net: selective, sector-rotating market rather than broad rally.
